description: Rule ids, severities and texts from the installed PINT AE Schematron (shared PINT rules and the -ae jurisdiction rules), filterable by severity or text, with fix hints where we have them. Free. Example: contains 'TaxPointDate'. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, message, fields, location, fix_hint, source = xsd | schematron | preflight), counts, ruleset version and timings, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Documents are validated in memory and never stored or logged.
name: list_rules
title: List the official PINT AE rules
